report: Checking visitor-center pages for the 24 NPS-matched national trail parks (ref order matches urls order: US-4565,US-4556,US-9757,US-4566,US-4567,US-4569,US-4568,US-4238,US-4571,US-4572,US-4573,US-4560,US-4561,US-4239,US-4575,US-4576,US-4577,US-4578,US-4564,US-4579,US-4580,US-4581,US-3791,US-4582). chat 2's NPS API pull of 'visitorcenters' for these 24 unit codes came back with ZERO centers for every one -- likely because linear trails rarely have a dedicated visitorcenters API entry even when their own website lists them. For each page: a 404/soft-404 means that trail has no dedicated visitorcenters.htm page (note it, I'll try planyourvisit/places-to-go.htm or placestogo.htm next for those); otherwise list every place named as a visitor center or interpretive center on the page (name, town/state, address if given).
